intro: ずつ deals out a quantity in equal portions: the same amount to each person, in each step, or each time. It always follows a word of quantity (二つ, 一人, 少し), and the sentence reads as so much per unit, or so much at a time.

skills.rule: Put ずつ straight after a number or quantity to say that amount each, or that amount at a time.
skills.explain:
ずつ has two closely linked readings. Distribution: everyone gets the same share, 一人に二つずつ配る (hand out two to each person). Steps: something happens in equal portions, 一日に十ページずつ読む (read ten pages a day), 一人ずつ入る (go in one at a time). 少しずつ (little by little) and 一歩ずつ (step by step) are the most common set phrases.

ずつ follows a quantity word: a number with a counter, 少し, 半分, いくつ. It does not follow a plain noun: say 学生に一冊ずつ, not 学生ずつ. The unit that receives each share often takes に: 一人に, 一日に, 一回に.

Do not confuse it with ごと, which means every (三日ごとに, every three days) or including (皮ごと, skin and all), or with だけ (only), ほど (about) and も after a number (as many as: 三時間も). If the idea is the same amount for each, or the same amount at a time, it is ずつ.
patterns: 少し / 一つ / 一人 ずつ

examples.jp: 一人[ひとり]{ずつ}部屋[へや]に入[はい]ってください。
examples.en: Please come into the room one at a time.

examples.jp: りんごとみかんを二[ふた]つ{ずつ}買[か]いました。
examples.en: I bought two apples and two mandarins.

examples.jp: 日本語[にほんご]が少[すこ]し{ずつ}分[わ]かるようになりました。
examples.en: Little by little, I've come to understand Japanese.

examples.jp: 子供[こども]たちにお菓子[かし]を三[みっ]つ{ずつ}あげました。
examples.en: I gave the children three sweets each.

examples.jp: 毎日[まいにち]単語[たんご]を十[じゅっ]個[こ]{ずつ}覚[おぼ]えています。
examples.en: I'm learning ten words a day.

examples.jp: ケーキを半分[はんぶん]{ずつ}食[た]べましょう。
examples.en: Let's have half the cake each.

contrast.note: 二つだけ is only two in total. 二つずつ is two each, so the total depends on how many people or items there are.
ごと is every or including: 一時間ごとに (every hour), 骨ごと (bones and all). ずつ is the same amount per unit: 一時間に二回ずつ (twice each hour).
After a number, も means as many as: 三つも食べた (I ate as many as three). 三つずつ食べた is we ate three each.

mistakes.bad: 学生[がくせい]{ずつ}本[ほん]を配[くば]った。
mistakes.good: 学生[がくせい]に本[ほん]を一冊[いっさつ]{ずつ}配[くば]った。
mistakes.note: ずつ follows the amount, not the people. The receivers take に.

mistakes.bad: 二日[ふつか]{ずつ}薬[くすり]を飲[の]みます。
mistakes.good: 二日[ふつか]{ごと}に薬[くすり]を飲[の]みます。
mistakes.note: Every two days is an interval, which is ごとに. ずつ would split an amount across days.

skills.tip: Can you say each or at a time right after the number in English? Then ずつ goes right after it in Japanese.
